prerequisites: LEPL1104: basic notions of numerical methods

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze an existing system and improve it.
Distinguish between reality and the models used to describe or modify it.
Apprehend the notion of uncertainty in the management of the project, in its realization, and in the results obtained.
Introduce engineering students to the application of theoretical knowledge acquired in the field of biomedical engineering.

syllabus_topics: Bibliographic study and understanding of the problem posed; establishment of specifications
Development of an appropriate methodology for solving the problem and an adequate experimental protocol
Debriefing session with the tutors and teachers in order to refine the analyzes and prepare the final report
Writing a final report and oral presentation
Study of cell-material interaction (cell growth, characterization and imaging techniques)
Design of an implant in a physiological medium
Measurement of physiological signals and extraction of physiological noise (EEG, ECG)
Analysis of movement control (walking, eye movements) based on the measurement of parameters and the mathematical modeling of the system studied.

assessment_methods.method: Written summary of a scientific article related to the project and presented orally
Written report of the project carried out in a group
Oral presentation of the project by the group

assessment_rules: If the individual exam is passed, the group evaluation has a weighting of 3/4. If the mark of the individual exam is lower than 6/20, the group evaluation has a weighting of 0. For a mark of the individual exam from 6/20 to 10/20, there is a linear progression in weighting between 0 and 3/4. The group evaluation mark from the first session will be the same for the second session; only the individual exam can be taken during the second session. Use of generative AI must be clearly and completely indicated.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
